assets.name: 30-lorikeet-hero-clean
assets.prompt: Use case: compositing. Edit the supplied synthetic rainbow lorikeet photograph to produce a much cleaner, more centrally composed wildlife hero. Landscape 3:2 photograph at highest available resolution. Recompose the bird so the bird's BODY is centred horizontally at x=50%, its sharp eye near the upper centre, with entire long tail and both feet visible and comfortable margins. Make the bird the unmistakable dominant focal point, occupying roughly 75% of image height. Keep the species-faithful blue-violet head, red-orange bill, golden-orange breast and emerald wings, authentic fine feather texture, lively sharp eye and believable anatomy. A natural three-quarter side pose, gently alert rather than leaning deep into flowers. One simple narrow weathered branch crossing lower third as perch, feet gripping it naturally. Remove ALL flowers, hanging leaves, framing twigs, background tree trunks and clutter from around the bird. Background should be an exceptionally smooth, deeply defocused dark forest-green backdrop, with just subtle soft tonal variation and a faint warm glow, no busy circular highlights or competing shapes. Beautiful gentle dawn side lighting illuminates the face and colourful feathers, subtle rim light and a few tiny dew droplets for atmosphere, rich realistic colours and natural shadows, camera-like microtexture and a restrained professional wildlife editorial finish. It should feel like an exquisite patient field photograph, not a studio cutout, illustration, CGI or heavily saturated HDR image. The visual story is the bird alone. No text, magazine border, logo, watermark, panels or UI. Do not imitate a specific published image.
